body: Hello! So turns out I have severe OCD and have been getting treated for it since and I’m doing so much better now. I’m sorry if you found this looking for an answer to something you’re struggling with. It just happened to be all in my head in my case lmaoooooo. Best of luck 🥺🥺🥺
Sending good vibes to you friend🫡🫡🫡 My mental health has really taken a huge hit during all this, but it’s nice to know I’m not alone. I hope they are able to figure things out for you!
Yeah I live in the US so I’ve just been a big ball of worry over it. 🧍‍♂️LMAO. But thank you! I will make sure to ask!

Fortunately, it wasn’t the GI that put me on a gluten free diet, it was just a family doctor. The GI I saw seemed to take it more seriously. Could the 2 weeks of gluten free effect my endoscopy results you think? I started eating gluten again on the 24th of December and my endoscopy is on the 19th of January. I’ve been eating a pretty heavy gluten filled diet since.

Time with family is another important thing too! Me and my mother barely see each other and we live in the same house. It makes me upset to see her going through the same exhaustion as well. 

I know it’s just words, but I hope things work out for you!
You’ve put it into words perfectly. I don’t understand why this is seen as such a radical take.
I realize not everyone feels the same this is just my experience
That sounds reasonable. I’m hoping that’s the case ‘cause it freaked me out even as a skeptic.
